task_title: QA filing: the Tier-1 lint arm skips silently when ruff is absent (format violation still passes)
task_criteria: This task grades the FILING ONLY, not the repair. At the graded commit: (a) .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl contains a row with id CF-094 and status pending whose acceptance_criteria state a check that can fail for each gap; (b) docs/audits/cf094-lint-skip-arms.sh and its committed transcript docs/audits/cf094-lint-skip-arms.txt are present in that same tree, the script is syntactically valid (bash -n exits 0), and the transcript shows both arms: with ruff on PATH the guard lint check fails and guard.passed is false, while with PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin the lint check reports outcome unknown and guard.passed is true with the same violating file staged; (c) bash scripts/boardctl validate prints RESULT: OK and bash tests/selftest.sh prints SELFTEST: PASS at that tree. The repair described by CF-094 is future work tracked by the pending row and is NOT expected at this commit.
